title: Third Degree Exemplification and Council Meeting
description: St. Genevieve Council 14772 gathered for a Third Degree Exemplification, followed later that afternoon by the Rosary and a council meeting in Madonna Hall.
article: St. Genevieve Council 14772 gathered on September 20, 2026, for a Third Degree Exemplification held from 12:00 to 2:30 p.m. Candidates, council members, families, and Knights in ceremonial regalia came together in prayer and fraternity as the candidates completed an important step in their journey of faith, unity, and service.

Later that afternoon, following the Rosary, the council reconvened at 4:00 p.m. in Madonna Hall for its business meeting. Members welcomed the newly exemplified Knights, shared council reports, and recognized service to the council. The day brought formation and fellowship together, strengthening the bonds that support the council’s work in the parish and community.

title: Team Pinnacle Membership and Feeding the Family Food Drive
description: St. Genevieve Council 14772 brought Team Pinnacle’s membership outreach together with the Feeding the Family Food Drive at St. Genevieve Parish Church. Knights, families, parishioners, and community members gathered in fellowship, welcomed prospective members, and collected food to help local families in need.

title: Bowling Day: Strikes, Smiles, and Fellowship
description: St. Genevieve Council 14772 brought members, families, and friends together at Back Alley Bowling for friendly competition, fellowship, trophies, and plenty of smiles.
article: St. Genevieve Council 14772 traded meeting tables for bowling lanes on September 24, 2026, gathering members, families, and friends at Back Alley Bowling for an afternoon shaped by friendly competition and easy fellowship.

Trophies and event displays welcomed participants as teams settled in and the lanes came alive. Between frames, the gathering offered plenty of time to reconnect, share laughs, and encourage one another—proof that the day was about much more than the final score.

The celebration concluded with recognition for the day’s bowlers and a group photo that captured the spirit of the event: joyful, welcoming, and united. Bowling Day brought the council community together through recreation, camaraderie, and memorable moments.
